text.p: The share parity to be used in a planned merger between holding company Cie de Suez and utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux will be 41 Suez shares for every 20 Lyonnaise, a source close to the talks told Reuters on Thursday.

Suez will pay a 1996 dividend of "23.60 or 24.60 francs" per share, the source added. The payout will include the annual payment and an exceptional amount which includes the capital gain on the sale of investment bank Banque Indosuez.
In the short term, Suez expected to keep its financial assets in the merged group, the source said.
Newspaper Le Monde reported on April 4 that the merger parity would be 41 Suez for 20 Lyonnaise shares and a 1996 dividend totalling 3.8 billion francs.
Neither company has confirmed the terms.
Excluding the shares held by Suez as treasury stock, about five percent of the issued capital, the public float comes to 155.6 million shares.
